verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Edge0 checkpoints carry a `config.json`, keep the base read-only and unmerged, and can run the plain base with `--no-lora`/`--no-prerouter`. It also offers a transformers-style API. None of this documents whether the downloaded files or caches can be used by other runtimes without re-downloading or converting. Reuse of one base across adapter sets inside Edge0 is an adjacent feature, not cross-runtime interoperability.
